issues.finding: The late year is the 2008 preprint year; the middle year is the 2010 journal year. These are the same work, not two mathematical results.
issues.resolution: Retain key Beauville2008 for stable citations. Set year=2010 with Journal of the Ramanujan Mathematical Society 25(3), 253–263; record first circulation arXiv v1, 2008-05-11 separately. The author publication list item [86] independently confirms 2010 and the journal pages.

issues.finding: Middle combines Proposition 5.5 and Proposition 5.11 under PDF p10. In arXiv v1 Proposition 5.5 is on printed/PDF p9, while Proposition 5.11 starts on p10 and finishes on p11.
issues.resolution: Use Theorem 3.3 p6; Proposition 5.5 p9; Proposition 5.11 pp10–11 for the 12-page arXiv v1. Do not apply those page numbers to the journal pagination.

issues.finding: Both records cite the 1972 LNM270 work, but consult different modern transcriptions and different exposés. The old marginal, revised printed, and PDF page numbers are not interchangeable.
issues.resolution: Union the Exposé V locators from late and Exposé VIII locators from middle, each with its own URL and edition/page mapping. Do not collapse all page numbers into one unqualified locator.

issues.finding: Early has introductory pp85–87; middle labels pp85–86 as §1; late locates §1 on p87. The exact shared main result is Theorems 5.1–5.2 p96.
issues.resolution: Call pp85–86 the introduction, §1 beginning p87, and retain the visually checked Theorems 5.1–5.2 p96 from late/middle. This is a locator refinement, not a conflict in the theorem or coefficient convention.

issues.finding: The records check complementary results: Theorem 1 numerical semisimplicity; Corollary 1 nilpotence for the homological-to-numerical kernel with algebraic Künneth projectors; Corollary 2 the sign-modified Tannakian conclusion.
issues.resolution: Union these qualified locators. Do not convert Corollary 1 into an unconditional nilpotence theorem for the Chow-to-numerical kernel.

issues.finding: HMS is the 2017 book consulted in an annotated 2025-07-01 file, including 2024 corrections to §9.5. Terenzi v2, 2026-08-19, still treats geometric connectedness as conjectural.
issues.resolution: Preserve original book year and consulted-file date. Preserve HMS Theorem9.1.16 versus Remark9.5.7, and Terenzi Proposition1.7/Corollary1.10/Remark1.11 p12. Neither the arithmetic exact sequence nor descent proves that its geometric kernel is the identity component.

issues.finding: The two current records agree with the actual primary front page: received 2024-05-30, final form 2025-05-29, published 2025-06-25. A possible earlier-run July 2025 revision gloss must not replace these facts.
issues.resolution: Keep publication 2025-06-25 and separately record that first public preprint circulation was not established. Theorem5.10 concerns exactness, not geometric connectedness.

issues.finding: All current records refer to the same original article. Corollary5.11 p131 identifies M(X[p]) with H1_dR(X); it does not require an extra quotient M(X[p])/p. The introduction states that the paper modifies a Harvard dissertation submitted in June1967.
issues.resolution: Union the original-article locators, DOI 10.24033/asens.1175, and dissertation/publication dates. Preserve the perfect-field and abelian-variety scope of Corollary5.11. Root and early independently inspected the original p131.

issues.finding: Voisin is a published 2025 Algebraic Geometry article; Alexandrou and the EGFS items remain verified preprint sources in these records. A year embedded in a key is not the current version year.
issues.resolution: Preserve Voisin DOI and publication metadata; record Alexandrou v1/v2 dates and restricted elliptic hypotheses. For EGFSMatroids retain first circulation 2025-07-21 separately from the checked v3 date 2026-03-27. Do not label a checked source theorem as independently proved in this run.

issues.finding: Four sources are explicitly unverified at theorem level (Auslander, Broe, Osgood, Giraud). Some verified Bourbaki records verify only publication metadata/contents; the TVS theorem text was read through a third-party scan.
issues.resolution: Retain every limitation. Do not upgrade an unverified theorem because a DOI or secondary citation exists. Do not portray the publisher-contents checks as primary theorem-text checks. Elementary algebra/reflection arguments are checked independently in the parts.

issues.finding: The README and full primary PDF were opened, including Theorem1.1 and the stated Tate/Hodge-standard consequences. The main theta construction was not independently verified here, and no journal publication was verified.
issues.resolution: Keep note=verified as source verification, together with the explicit proof-status limitation. Do not use this bibliography flag to claim an established general settlement of CM Hodge or all finite-field abelian Tate conjectures.

issues.finding: Talk/conference years and stable citation keys differ from publication years. issues.resolution: Retain the stated separate dates. Do not infer publication years from filenames or keys. Keep n.d. for the checked Mumford–Oda draft unless another primary edition is opened.
